[center]    [img]https://i.imgur.com/t6WVo96.png[/img]


Transform your farmhouse into a cozy castle! ~ Includes seasonal variants, all three upgrade levels, plus a matching shipping bin, mailbox replacements & more.

Some upgrade levels are slightly larger/smaller than vanilla, so I’ve added custom collision maps (on by default) to prevent visual glitches like colliding with invisible walls around the farmhouse.


By default lilac petals, the shipping bin and mailbox are off. They can be toggled on via Generic Config Menu 

[img width=516,height=60]https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXd6HwUkDKe9T72j3K8OwkkchjWiGLSa_4W8qdxEATFJSYxbbCiFzAX6RH54Ot_087I6DpSg6r6DvPtq_qbQFlVxxKq2YUOEmtv06kSFixiAUJ0imWrLY7-hbjWKL-e0vcY3nUencQ?key=SworC8vVRoJ2neaPIeQuwg[/img]

I’m planning to create more castle-themed redesigns for other farm buildings, the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39396]greenhouse[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44126]coop[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43936]barn[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37189]stable[/url]﻿ have already been completed. When they are all finished, I'll release them as one big buildin' pack.

Feel free to share any ideas or requests for this series with me!

**I will slowly (slightly sporadically, between buildings) be working on some recolor support and at some pointttt I'll see about making the buildings paint-able at Robins.


 [img width=516,height=60]https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfx4ZGAK6-NlnOMmSuzzJXT6Nwte9CMkG7nA62LOETE_tiQ0jKtAySM5uGymSHbss7akgC8I_d9uXYOACnAWVzbFtZFAkiOSBuOU5wAaVrIexyR8YcEHDRusSq_SCFogrWRcqSDxg?key=SworC8vVRoJ2neaPIeQuwg[/img]

I only started making this retexture because I found myself excitedly checking through [url=http://next.nexusmods.com/profile/FlashShifter?gameId=1303&pk_vid=b8cc2fa761b328a61755051662c71015]Flashshifter[/url]﻿'s Patreon for news of SVE's Castle Village update/sequel mod, and I got the itch to create some castle-themed Stardew art, so here we are! S.O. to Flashshifter, their creativity is catching. I studied their art style and the color palettes from Lance's Highlands Outpost to design the castles.

My thanks to the modders on the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url]﻿ Discord who helped with troubleshooting! Special thanks to chuwu in particular! 

Lastly, the flowers on the decorated version of the mod are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20139]HxW Tilesheets[/url]﻿, a gigantic thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/HimeTarts?gameId=1303]HimeTarts[/url]﻿ and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Wildflourmods?gameId=1303]Wildflour[/url]﻿ for their beautiful mods and for making their work available for the community to use.
